name: trading-tracker-2026
description: Trading Tracker 2026 Web and Android App

scripts.sync-assets: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); ['index.html','privacy-policy.html','terms.html','disclaimer.html','about.html','contact.html','blog.html','manifest.json','sw.js','profile-data.js','qrcode.min.js','profile.jpg','profile.ico','favicon.ico','version.json'].forEach(f=>{if(fs.existsSync(f)) fs.copyFileSync(f,'www/'+f)}); console.log('✅ Synced web assets to www/ directory!');"
scripts.sync-www: npm run sync-assets && npx cap sync

author: Anurag Patel
